title: RNA-seq to investigate gene expression after HCV eradication with IFN therapy in HIV/HCV-coinfected patients
description: We conducted a prospective study in 28 HIV/HCV-coinfected patients receiving IFN-based therapy at baseline (HIV/HCV-b) and week 24 after the sustained virological response (HIV/HCV-f). Twenty-seven HIV-monoinfected patients (HIV-group) were included as a control group, which were effectively treated with cART (virological controlled and CD4+ T-cell counts over 500) for an extended period. RNA-seq analysis was performed on peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs).

samples.title: 029b
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral venous blood samples were collected in EDTA tubes. Total RNA was extracted from Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells with the RNeasy minikit (Qiagen™), according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Libraries were synthesize with the Illumina’s TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Prep Kit v2 using 500 nanogram of total RNA following manufacturer’s protocol.
